name: Porch Restaurant (Daybreak / South Jordan) Buttermilk Biscuits & Roasted Chicken or Shrimp & Grits
brandOrRestaurant: Porch Restaurant (Daybreak / South Jordan near Herriman, UT)
whyItWorks: Just minutes from Holiday Inn Express Herriman/South Jordan in Daybreak, Porch serves scratch-made warm buttermilk biscuits with honey butter, herb-roasted chicken with mashed potatoes, and creamy cheddar grits.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Roasted Chicken with whipped potatoes or the Buttermilk Biscuits; if ordering Shrimp & Grits, ask for mild seasoning (no spicy tasso/cayenne gravy).
watchOuts: Skip fried green tomatoes, collard greens, and spicy jalapeño cornbread
